cited.quote: In order to eliminate manual cleaning of septic tanks and promote safe, mechanized desludging

rationale: C1 reports mechanized desludging vehicles and a helpline but shows no executive order banning manual removal of human waste. No official ban step appears in any extract.

cited.quote: In line with the Government of Tamil Nadu's commitment to eradicate manual scavenging

rationale: C3 mentions mechanization of sewerage maintenance by CMWSSB but no state-level committee or helpline for reporting manual scavenging. Other extracts concern unrelated helplines and committees.

cited.quote: pleased to announce the launch of the AI Industry Development Program

rationale: C3 is a budget speech announcement of an AI programme; no administrative order detailing its initiatives appears. C1 cites a GO on routing AI proposals, which is not an initiatives order.

cited.quote: TN AI mission shall be a project management and execution agency

rationale: C1 describes the AI Mission's mandate and roles in a policy note, but no implementation guidelines are shown as officially released. Other extracts are unrelated or plans.

cited.quote: 5% interest subsidy for a period of 5 years on term loans up to Rs.200 lakh

rationale: C1 and C2 show existing MSME interest subsidy schemes at 5% and 3%, not loans at 4% from a new fund. No GO or launch of a 4 percent loan fund appears.

cited.quote: funds are allocated to the extent of 20.01 percent and 1.17 percent respectively

rationale: C3 describes a population-proportion allocation and a 2024 Act, predating the government. C1 and C2 report allocations only. No new guidelines for exclusive use of funds are shown.

cited.quote: Under the Special Components Plan for the Adi Dravidar, an allocation of Rs.25,225 crore has been made

rationale: C1 is a budget speech noting allocations under sub-plans; budget statements of allocation do not count as operationalisation, and no exclusivity mechanism is shown. The Act in other extracts predates the government.
No extract concerns a Happiness Ecosystem for mental health and social harmony. Extracts cover SHG livelihoods, environment and a hospital patient safety framework.

established at a cost of Rs. 4.70 crore, is dedicated to training

cited.quote: Pre-departure orientation training centres have been established in seven districts of Tamil Nadu

rationale: C1 and C2 describe existing NRT welfare schemes and board services continuing, with no new guidelines issued. Other extracts are unrelated. No dedicated new measure is shown.

cited.quote: Various initiatives for the Welfare of Non-Resident Tamils are being undertaken through the Commissionerate

rationale: C3 shows NRT welfare work by the Commissionerate but no committee formed to oversee NRT schemes. Committees in C4 and C5 concern health matters.

cited.quote: a dedicated cell comprising experts will be established to undertake marketing

rationale: C1 is a policy note plan for a marketing cell for organic produce including traditional rice, with no Ponni-specific or global marketing step and no GO. Statement of intent only.

cited.quote: G.O.(Ms) No.131, Commercial Taxes and Registration (J1) Department, dated 01.12.2023 notifies the stamp duty reduction

rationale: C1 shows a stamp duty reduction dated 2023, before the government took office. C4 constitutes a revenue augmentation committee, not an order to reduce residential owners' tax burden.

cited.quote: to suggest measures for the sustainable augmentation of the State's tax and non-tax revenues

rationale: C5 constitutes a committee to augment revenues, which is opposite to reducing residential owners' tax burden. No policy to reduce residential tax burden appears.
No extract concerns tax concessions for conversion of heritage houses or bungalows into lodging. Tourism extracts cover riverfronts, boat houses and rest houses only.

cited.quote: NSHIP-TN secured the first in-principle approval from the Directorate General of Shipping on 06.04.2026
